authTierRationale: The only credential mode is a single self-serve Brevo API key (EndpointConfig.credentials is a one-variant discriminated union of ApiKey). TokenSource is constructed with oauth_spec=None, so no OAuth app registration or refresh token is ever involved and no hosted control plane is required. The key is placed verbatim into the `api-key` request header.

unionMisfits.description: The offset paginator is faithful in shape, but three behaviours the source treats as load-bearing are not expressible: (1) every paginated request pins a constant `sort=asc`, because Brevo's `desc` default renumbers the whole result set on every insert, which for an offset walk shifts rows across page boundaries and for a snapshot stream rewrites every `/_meta/row_id`; the schema's `params` can carry it but nothing marks it as pagination-critical rather than an ordinary filter. (2) `offset` advances by the number of rows actually returned, not by a fixed pageSize — the backfill's cutoff filter suppresses rows from emission but they still count toward the advance (tests/test_contacts_cursor.py::test_backfill_advances_by_rows_read_not_rows_emitted). (3) `paginator: none` here means 'send no limit/offset/sort at all', not 'request page one'; the source states Brevo rejects surprising parameters and a test pins the param dict to empty.

The webhooks stream is not one request but a fan-out: GET /webhooks filters on `type` and defaults to `transactional`, so the connector issues one request per value of (marketing, transactional, inbound) and unions the disjoint results into a single snapshot. A PullSpec has one `params` map with scalar values and no way to express 'iterate this param'. Additionally, Brevo reports 'no webhooks of this type' as HTTP 400 with `document_not_found` rather than an empty array, and the connector swallows that — but only when raised before that type has yielded a row, because a mid-walk truncation would make the CDK tombstone (delete) live rows.

The backfill and incremental legs are not disjoint by query — both hit GET /contacts with the same paginator. Disjointness is enforced client-side: the backfill drops any row whose `modifiedAt` >= the backfill cutoff, leaving those to the incremental sweep. The schema has no field for a client-side cutoff predicate applied to a backfill leg.

clientSideCutoff.value: backfill cutoff captured at binding open

unionMisfits.description: `format: iso8601` under-specifies. Brevo requires exactly `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (millisecond precision, literal Z); the source builds it by hand precisely because datetime.isoformat() emits microseconds and a +00:00 offset, which Brevo does not accept. Also, the cursor written back is the sweep-START instant, not max(modifiedAt), because /contacts cannot be sorted by modification date and has no modifiedBefore bound — a semantic the schema has no place to record.

abstained.transports[0].spec.defaultHeaders: No headers are set anywhere in the connector beyond the auth header; no accept/user-agent/version pin appears in source_brevo/. estuary_cdk's HTTPSession may add generic transport headers, but none are connector-specified. Reported as null meaning 'none specified by this connector'.
abstained.discovery: Null by construction: the stream list is a hardcoded SNAPSHOT_RESOURCES list plus contacts (source_brevo/resources.py:145-148). The connector's `discover` RPC just re-emits that static list; nothing is read from the customer's account to determine which streams exist.
abstained.execution.continuity: Null: mode is poll, and no server-side artifact is created on Brevo's side. Every request is a plain GET against a REST collection; nothing accrues on the customer side and nothing expires on ours if we stop between ticks (the contacts cursor is a wall-clock timestamp with no retention window, and backfills restart from a stored integer offset).
abstained.streams[0].cursorField: The document field used for the cutoff/emission decision is `modifiedAt` (api.py:233) and the request filter is `modifiedSince`. But the checkpointed LogCursor is NOT a value read off any record — it is the sweep-start wall clock instant, deliberately not max(modifiedAt). So `modifiedAt` names the filtered field, not a record-derived cursor; treat the value as approximate.
abstained.streams[].primaryKeyKind: For the six snapshot streams, the key `/_meta/row_id` is not declared in the connector's Python at all — it comes from the CDK's SnapshotResource machinery and is visible only in the generated acmeCo/flow.yaml and discover snapshot. Classified `synthetic` on that basis; if the CDK's snapshot keying changes this changes with it.
abstained.streams[6].pull.snapshot.params.type: The value recorded is a description of a fan-out over three literal values, not a single sendable parameter value. The schema's params map has no representation for 'iterate'; see unionMisfits[1] for the real shape. Do not send the string literally.
abstained.checkStream / connection test: validate_credentials hits GET /v3/account (resources.py:50-52) — chosen because it is unpaginated, always present, and readable by every API key. /account is NOT one of the captured streams and has no model in models.py, so it cannot be recorded as a stream; there is no schema field for a non-stream health-check endpoint either. Recorded here so the fact is not lost.
